review_comments.body:
** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Make the timeout cases deterministic.** A nanosecond timeout does not guarantee that the timeout branch wins. If the failing refresh completes before the handler selects, the completion branch can return the refresh error. Go does not prioritize an expired timer over another ready case. The timeout assertions at Line 514 or Line 527 can therefore fail under a valid schedule. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/golang/go/go1.26.10/doc/go_spec.html)) Use a controlled blocking refresh for the timeout cases. Release it after the timeout response, then wait for the background work to finish.

**Explanation** The title "fix(views): return cached panels when refresh fails" matches the main change. The raw summary shows handleViewRefresh now uses cached data on refresh failure or timeout, gated by the last refresh time and table availability, and the tests cover panels-only refresh fallback with and without a matching cached fingerprint. The title is specific, concise, and follows a conventional commit style.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#3537` requires that panels-only views return cached panels with refreshStatus: error, refreshError, and responseSource: cache when a refresh times out or fails, provided a cached view_panels row exists for the request fingerprint. It also requires an error, not an empty cached result, when the fingerprint has no cache. The AI-generated summary states that handleViewRefresh now calls getLastRefresh for the view UID and request fingerprint, and allows fallback when a prior refresh exists and either the view has no table or the table exists. This matches the issue's suggested fix. The reviewed diff for views/table.go and views/table_test.go could not be read; both diff requests returned that changed blobs are missing from the checkout. A read of views/table.go at head was truncated before handleViewRefresh, so the changed code was not verified directly. The four Ginkgo cases are described in the PR description and summary but were not read, and no test run was verified. **Resolution** Make the diff for views/table.go and views/table_test.go readable at the reviewed head, or make the changed blobs available. Then confirm in handleViewRefresh that the fallback on refresh error and on timeout uses the fingerprint-specific getLastRefresh check, and that the no-cache case returns the error. Confirm that the four Panels-only refresh fallback cases exist and assert the panel contents, error status, cache usage, and no-cache error.
